desc.en: An ointment made from mixing several medicinal plants. Its most common use is direct application to inflammation or cuts, but it can also be absorbed by eating it. It's quite bitter, and children don't like it.
desc.ja: 数種類の薬草を混ぜ込んだ塗り薬。炎症や切り傷の患部に直接塗るのが一般的だが、口から摂取することもできる。ちなみに、かなり苦く、子供は嫌がる

desc.en: Effect: Selecting this property increases the item's effect power by 10％.
desc.ja: 効果：調合の潜力選択時に選択すると、アイテムの効力を１０％上昇させる

desc.en: Effect: Increases the item's critical chance by 15％.
desc.ja: 効果：アイテムが１５％の確率でクリティカルする

desc.en: Heals wounds, restoring HP to the target.
desc.ja: 傷を治し、対象のＨＰを回復する

desc.en: The target recovers a small amount of HP.
desc.ja: 対象のＨＰを少し回復する

desc.en: Reduces the wait time after the target's next turn by a small amount.
desc.ja: 対象が次に行動したとき、行動後の待機時間を少し短縮する
対象の弱体化の状態異常を回復する
